items.source: rclone provider contract, metadata mapper, OneDrive normalization, and local memory-provider evidence plus Syncthing device/folder/config normalization evidence in lane manifests
items.essentialCapability: Normalizes local-only object, directory, timestamp, hash, case, tier, device, and folder metadata so sync decisions and review payloads behave like upstream without requiring live provider credentials.
items.scopeBoundary: In scope: local provider object schemas, path and case normalization, timestamp precision, content-type/storage-tier metadata, provider IDs/parent IDs, synthetic directory metadata, device/folder config projections, and deterministic sanitized output. Out of scope: live cloud provider tests, OAuth flows, tenant-specific APIs, network remotes, secret handling, remote mutation, and cloud application wrappers.
items.testExpectation: Require rclone provider contract/local memory-provider evidence, rclone metadata mapper and OneDrive normalization fixtures, plus Syncthing device/folder/config metadata evidence, with PHP pass/fail counts for object/directory metadata, path/case/time/tier/hash parity, sanitized device/folder projections, invalid timestamp, impossible hash, duplicate ID, parent cycle, case collision, traversal, unsupported tier, malformed device/folder ID, and redaction-failure cases. No progress credit for rclone/Syncthing shell-outs, live provider/service remotes, credential/config inspection, OAuth, FUSE, Docker-backed provider suites, or cloud application wrappers.
items.reuseNotes: Reuse charset-encoding-core, unicode-text-repair-width, checksum-hash-suite, glob-filter-pathspec-core, and url-percent-encoding-core once present; keep service-specific adapters local and fixture-backed so provider behavior remains testable without credentials.
items.blocker: Activate only for local-only provider or Syncthing device/folder metadata normalization blockers; live-service provider coverage, OAuth, credential-bearing configs, and remote mutation remain excluded by default.
